purpose: Replacing an exact governed lint level with a group allow (pedantic/nursery/restriction) silently widens the exemption surface.

dishonest_mutation.content:
# dishonest gate fragment swapping exact denials for a group allow
cargo clippy --workspace --lib --locked -- -A clippy::pedantic

positive_counterpart.note: Exact flags stay exact; no group allows.
positive_counterpart.content:
cargo clippy --workspace --lib --locked \
  -- -D warnings -A missing_docs &&
cargo clippy --workspace --bins --locked --no-deps \
  -- -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used
